name: myHomework
description: The signed-in learner's homework (DBU-06; security: authenticated). With a stepId: that homework (brief, hand-in list, resources, due date, status, its number) and every version they handed in, newest first. Without one: their shared homework, in plan order, for the Homework tab. Refuses a step that is not a shared homework of the caller's; who is asking comes from the session and nothing else.
